summary: ADR-0050 accepted 2026-07-29; extends ADR-0048, complements but does not supersede ADR-0044/0048; sole formal LKG recovery: publish_knowledge_catalog.py --restore-lkg; recovery lock plus LKG/generation/artifact/source/policy/query/main verification; stale LKG allowed only ancestor with all indexed and bundled inputs byte-matching main; restore source snapshot, v2 catalog, consumer projections, v1 compatibility catalog; validate current publication, replay query gate, canonical Locator smoke; stale LKG never promotes over newer main; rollback domain=four layers/current/LKG/success evidence, current written last; activation/restore failures preserve generation and verify rollback bytes; publication control-plane scripts must byte-match pinned main; lock recovery only dead/reused owner or malformed lock after 60s, otherwise conflict; pruning only explicit prune_knowledge_generations.py --prune, never publication/recovery; protect current/LKG/five newest valid successful added-to-main generations; retention ordering excludes mtime; invalid/uncommitted/unrecognized dirs report-only; pruning policy from current main, intent+per-target authorization+atomic isolation+outcome evidence; failure evidence append-only logs/knowledge-context and never pruned; retention changes require policy and ADR update
